draft.title: Preview: {name}

panel.autoNextOffHint: Off: the next song is not selected after you finish (songs picked on the results screen still are). Press to turn on
panel.autoNextOnHint: On: after you finish a song from the mix, select the next song in the list when you are back in song select. Press to turn off
panel.ceilingOnHint: On: in every type, exclude maps harder than 97% of your recent clears (by Pass rating). Press to turn off
panel.ceilingOffHint: Off: no difficulty cap (difficulty is still matched as usual). Press to turn on
panel.filterHint: Switch what the list shows: All → Familiar (installed only) → New songs (not installed yet)

panel.noSong: Select a song to get recommendations from here
panel.pinHint: Switch between pinning and moving the panel. Moving shows a handle on top and turns the bottom row into “Put it back where it started”
panel.putBack: Put it back where it started
panel.refreshHint: Press to clear the notice and check the connection to OctantCompass again. Pairing is done in the OctantCompass connection settings
panel.resetHint: Put the panel back where it started (above the song list)
panel.saveHint: Keep the current list as a playlist
panel.savedHint: Already saved (a playlist with these songs exists)
panel.songHint: Press to pick a type of recommendation, starting from the selected song (OctantPath)
playlist.mixDescription: The OctantPath mix (replaced each time you create one)

playlist.savedDescription: A playlist saved from an OctantPath mix
playlist.trialDescription: Maps OctantPath downloaded from OctantCompass recommendations
playlist.unreadable: Can't read {file}.bplist, so it isn't rewritten
presets.failed: Couldn't get the list of mix types ({detail})
presets.none: Haven't received the mix types from OctantCompass
profile.notEnough: Not enough plays yet to estimate your skill
profileView.title: Estimated skill and taste
recommend.badRequest: OctantCompass said the request was malformed: {error}
recommend.seedNotEmbedded: No recommendations (this song hasn't been computed in the DB yet)

recommend.unknownPreset: That button isn't in OctantCompass's current list. The buttons were rebuilt
seed.noneChoice: No starting song (pick a song to also get types that start from it)
select.failed: Couldn't select it in song select. Pick it from the OctantPath pack
settings.autoDeleteHint: While off, nothing is deleted; the maps that would be deleted are only written to the log
settings.autoDownloadHint: When off, trial frames and the next songs of a mix aren't downloaded automatically. Trial songs already downloaded are still cleaned up by the day and size limits either way
settings.exportSummaryHint: Writes a summary of the recommendations (per type: shown, skipped, downloaded, played, cleared, liked) to UserData/OctantPath/summaries. Nothing is sent
settings.languageHint: Language of OctantPath's screens. Used after pressing OK (the game restarts its menu)
settings.mixDraftCountHint: How many songs a mix lists before you create it
settings.mixPrefetchCountHint: How many of the next songs in a mix are downloaded in advance (only while auto download is on)
settings.panelOpacityHint: How solid the tiles of the song select panel and the background of the results panel are (both use this value). Raise it if bright things behind make the text hard to read
settings.panelScaleHint: Size of the recommendation panel over song select (relative to BSML's standard floating screen)
settings.shortcutHint: The type shown in the bottom row of the panel above song select. "Recently used" fills it with the types you picked recently
settings.trialExpiryHint: Trial songs still on trial after this many days (only days you launch the game count) are deleted at launch (along with the size limit; songs you played a few times are kept)
settings.trialMaxHint: When the trial songs go over this, the oldest are deleted at launch (along with the day limit; songs in other playlists are kept)
signals.countMismatch: OctantCompass holds {host} signals, not the {sent} that were sent
